# Occasion

> GenAI planning assistant for weddings, birthdays and community events, built for Prompt Wars (Hack2Skill x Google), Challenge 5: Celebration & Event Planner. Rules compute the budget, timeline and vendor checklist so money and dates are always right; Gemini adds personal ideas, extra tasks, money-saving tips and a summary, and turns plain-language change requests into checked field changes.

- Live app: https://occasion-event-planner.vercel.app
- Demo video: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1FETHGWW5HfSp-t5cJyqmHsXEoG-USNoV/view?usp=sharing
- Stack: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, Bun, TypeScript, Zod 4, Gemini API (@google/genai), Vercel

## Docs

- [README](README.md): overview, features mapped to the challenge, how to run
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): rules vs Gemini split, request flow, modules, personalization rules
- [API](docs/API.md): POST /api/plan and POST /api/refine, schemas, errors
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): risks, controls, files and tests
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): 57 tests and what each file covers
- [Accessibility](docs/ACCESSIBILITY.md): WCAG 2.1 AA measures, axe-core result

## Key source files

- [src/lib/plan/](src/lib/plan/): pure planning rules (schema, budget, timeline, vendors, dates, refine, validation)
- [src/lib/ai/planner.ts](src/lib/ai/planner.ts): createPlan and refineInput, rules first then Gemini
- [src/lib/ai/gemini.ts](src/lib/ai/gemini.ts): Gemini client with model fallback and shared deadline
- [src/app/api/plan/route.ts](src/app/api/plan/route.ts), [src/app/api/refine/route.ts](src/app/api/refine/route.ts): route handlers
- [src/components/planner/](src/components/planner/): form, plan sheet, refine box, usePlanner hook
- [tests/](tests/): bun test suites
